ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Bidder Submission Package — Tender TENDER-2026-001
1. Company Registration Certificate
This is to certify that ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (CIN: U72900MH2015PTC268471) is a company
duly incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at Plot 47, MIDC
Industrial Area, Pune, Maharashtra - 411019, India. Certificate of Incorporation issued by the
Registrar of Companies, Mumbai. The company has been in continuous operation since 2015.
2. GST Registration Certificate
GSTIN: 27ABCDE1234F1Z5. Legal Name: ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Trade Name: ABC
Technologies. Registration valid and Active as on date. Constitution of Business: Private Limited
Company. GST registration is valid and in good standing with no pending compliance issues.
3. Experience Certificate
ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd. has over 7 years of experience in infrastructure and engineering
services, having been actively engaged in similar works since March 2019. The company has
successfully completed 4 similar projects in the last five years, including two municipal infrastructure
contracts and two departmental works contracts of comparable scope and value.

5. Audited Financial Statement — Turnover Certificate
Chartered Accountant Certificate: This is to certify that the average annual turnover of ABC

6. Bid Security / Earnest Money Deposit
Demand Draft No. 884213 dated 02-Sep-2026 drawn on HDFC Bank, Pune Branch, in favour of
'Maharashtra Works Department' for an amount of Rs. 10,00,000 (Rupees Ten Lakhs only)
submitted as Bid Security / Earnest Money Deposit for Tender TENDER-2026-001.

7. Authorised Signatory Declaration
I, Rakesh Kulkarni, Managing Director of ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd., hereby declare that all
information and documents submitted in this bid are true and correct to the best of my knowledge,
and that the company is not blacklisted or debarred by any government authority in India.
Authorised Signatory: Rakesh Kulkarni, Managing Director
